name: fusion-con-sazon
description: Sitio de Fusión con Sazón: backend Express + Prisma y frontend React + Vite, con panel de administrador.

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run setup:deps && npm run setup:db
scripts.setup:deps: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup:db: cd backend && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate deploy && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend exec tsc -- --noEmit
